# Metrics catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/metrics_catalog.py from the dbt semantic manifest. Do not edit by hand. -->

Query any metric with MetricFlow, e.g.
`mf query --metrics offensive_rating --group-by team__team_abbreviation`.

- **certified**: reviewed, known-answer tested, safe to publish.
- **experimental**: useful, with a documented caveat; may change without notice.

## Experimental (3)

| Metric | Label | Type | Definition | Owner | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pace` | Pace | derived | `(team_possessions + opp_possessions) / (2 * games_rated)` | analytics_engineering | Average possessions per team per game: (possessions + opponent possessions) / 2 / games. Not adjusted to 48 minutes, so overtime games raise it slightly. |
| `points_per_possession_after_turnover` | Points per possession after a turnover | ratio | `possession_points` where possession__start_reason = 'turnover' / `possession_count` where possession__start_reason = 'turnover' | basketball_analytics | Points per possession for possessions that start right after the opponent turned it over. A proxy for transition offense (ESPN does not flag fast breaks per play). |
| `wins_last_30_days` | Wins, last 30 days | cumulative | trailing 30 days of `team_wins` | analytics_engineering | Wins in the trailing 30 days. Calendar window, so it spans the All-Star break. |

## Building blocks (23)

Simple metrics auto-created from measures (`create_metric: true`) to feed the metrics above. Prefer the published metrics.

`effective_field_goals`, `field_goals_attempted`, `games_with_possessions`, `offensive_rebound_chances`, `offensive_rebounds`, `opponent_possessions`, `player_games_played`, `player_minutes`, `player_points`, `player_true_shooting_attempts`, `possession_count`, `possession_points`, `possession_seconds`, `possessions_with_offensive_rebound`, `rated_opponent_points`, `rated_points`, `rated_turnovers`, `scoring_possessions_with_offensive_rebound`, `shot_points`, `shots_made`, `team_points`, `three_pointers_attempted`, `true_shooting_attempts`

## Semantic models (7)

| Semantic model | Gold model | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `games` | `dim_games_v2` | Scheduled games (gold dim_games, latest version). Adds venue and game-type context. |
| `player_games` | `fct_player_games` | One row per rostered player per game (gold fct_player_games). |
| `players` | `dim_players` | Player versions (gold dim_players, type 2). MetricFlow joins the version that was valid at each fact's metric_time, so a traded player's stats group under the right attributes. |
| `possessions` | `fct_possessions` | One row per possession (gold fct_possessions). Team is the offense. |
| `shots` | `fct_shots` | One row per field goal attempt (gold fct_shots). Player is the shooter. |
| `team_games` | `fct_team_games` | One row per team per completed game (gold fct_team_games). Basis for team efficiency, shooting and results metrics. Ratings use "rated_" measures that only count games with play-by-play, so numerators and possession denominators always cover the same games. |
| `teams` | `dim_teams` | NBA franchises (gold dim_teams). Adds team names to any metric grouped by team. |
